hooks.command: echo '{"systemMessage": "Journal check: if any non-obvious design decisions, rejected approaches, or surprising behaviours were discussed this session, add an entry to JOURNAL.md."}'

input=$(cat); branch=$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|&&|\||;)\s*git\s+commit' && { [ "$branch" = "main" ] || [ "$branch" = "master" ]; }; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Direct commits to main/master are not allowed. Create a feature branch first with: git checkout -b <branch-name>"}}'; fi
